summary: Registered transport build: host C/C++ layouts/shared peer, 50000 ASan/UBSan mutation/control attempts and seven bad-backend replies pass; eight compile-only AArch64 ELF/arm64 iOS16.5 Mach-O C/C++ objects built without SDK
